Secret.

In reply, state NUMBER and DATE.

dated 3.10.41.

Dear Hilary,

Reference your P.F.41426/F.2a/EHC of 23.8.41:

It is confirmed that GOULD VERSCHOYLE is still interned. So far we have not been able to get any information as to whether any of the other fourteen Communists were also interned, but will let you know if and when further details are forthcoming.

Yours sincerely,

Miss E.H. Creedy,
M.I.5.
